digest.component_or_area: rebar llm model-class configuration and resolution
propositions: Model tier selection is inferred from an equality test against the framework default rather than expressed as configuration, so Pass-2/Pass-4 and completion verifier downgrades silently stop applying on non-default (Bedrock) model ids.
code-review.yaml declares no model on any step, so all four code-review passes take cfg.model and never downgrade.
plan-review.yaml's model_ladder uses bare claude-* names that config.py resolves to provider anthropic, causing a split-brain where Pass-1 finders hit direct Anthropic on a Bedrock run.

Introduce three capability classes (trivial/standard/frontier) as config slots the operator fills with model/provider/endpoint plus optional fallback chain; internal call sites reference the class not a model id.

REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE layers over discovered config with deep recursive table merge (leaf key wins) and wholesale array replacement, keeping secrets env-only and leaving read_reserved_section's shared shallow merge untouched.
REBAR_LLM_MODEL is deprecated with a migration window rather than kept as a permanent alias.
